I fixed issue #920 in the `node-bot` repo by simplifying the `BASE_WHISPER_PROMPT` string in `whisper-prompt.js`. I changed it to just "Mana" (plus "and wake up" for natural flow), since `WakeWordMatcher` already handles the variants on its own.

I added a new test that specifically checks the `BASE_WHISPER_PROMPT` content to ensure the misspellings are gone, and all 15 tests pass. This becomes the PR description.

I fixed issue #920 by simplifying the `BASE_WHISPER_PROMPT` in `node-bot/whisper-prompt.js`. The prompt was listing six wake-word variants ("Mana, Manah, Manna, Mannah, Myna, My Na"), which whisper was copying and teaching itself to misspell "Mana". I trimmed it down to just "Mana" and "wake up", keeping the prompt under 450 chars.

I then added a new test (`test("the base prompt's wake word list only has 'Mana', not misspellings (#920)")`) that asserts "Mana" is present and none of the old misspellings appear. All 15 tests pass.
